description: Boundary and special-character coverage for the observer error log line. Exercises empty messages, whitespace-only messages, embedded newlines/tabs, unicode, prefixed exception strings, and JSON-like payloads, verifying the error's own string representation is emitted verbatim with a single trailing newline.

input.error: 网络错误: 连接超时 ⚠

cases.expected_output: 网络错误: 连接超时 ⚠
